attributes: Abu Dhabi (UAE): Desert with sand dunes; extremely hot; air-conditioned sealed buildings; loose cotton clothes with head covered; rain is very scarce; WATER IS SCARCER AND MORE EXPENSIVE THAN PETROL (petroleum is found underground); dominant tree is DATE PALM (खजूर); currency is DIRHAM (दिरहम) with Arabic script; flight takes ~2 hours from India
Kerala: Lush greenery, coconut/banana trees, abundant monsoon rains, Indian Rupee currency
